critical_threats.threat: Remote cache returns malicious bytes for a valid digest
critical_threats.unresolved: Compromised hash implementation or chosen-prefix weaknesses remain outside this layer.

critical_threats.threat: Worker reads ambient host files or credentials
critical_threats.unresolved: Kernel or hypervisor compromise can escape the sandbox.

critical_threats.threat: Action key omits an input and serves stale output
controls: key includes command, environment, platform, toolchain, policy and input root
critical_threats.unresolved: Build-system rule authors can misdeclare semantic inputs.

critical_threats.threat: Two reproducible builders share the same compromised toolchain
critical_threats.unresolved: Reproducibility alone does not defeat a trusting-trust compiler compromise.

critical_threats.threat: Nondeterministic build is admitted because one cached result hides variation
critical_threats.unresolved: Rare race-dependent nondeterminism may evade bounded trials.
Semantic malicious output can still hash correctly and requires reproducibility/review.

critical_threats.threat: Build graph or cache becomes unrecoverable proprietary state
critical_threats.unresolved: Rule semantics may still depend on one build-system implementation.
